<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->

<!--
  A checkout on one page: contacts, address, a delivery window, the payment and the consent as stacked steps,
  beside a sticky order summary with the lines, a promo code and the totals. Static markup. Axes: layout (cards:
  each step in a card, numbered: numbered steps divided by a line), summary (aside, none), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { CheckoutLabels } from "./checkout-form.types";
import type { Day } from "../components/slot-grid.types";
import type { Payment } from "../components/payment-options.types";
import type { CartLine } from "./cart-list.types";
import type { SummaryRow } from "./order-summary.types";
import type { Promo, CartSummaryLabels } from "../components/cart-summary-card.types";

export type CheckoutFormProps = {
  id: string;
  title?: string;
  days: Day[];
  payments: Payment[];
  lines: CartLine[];
  rows: SummaryRow[];
  promos: Promo[];
  labels: CheckoutLabels;
  totals: CartSummaryLabels;
  layout?: "cards" | "numbered";
  summary?: "aside" | "none";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Form from "../primitives/form/form.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Input from "../primitives/input/input.vue";
import Textarea from "../primitives/textarea/textarea.vue";
import CartSummaryCard from "../components/cart-summary-card.vue";
import CheckoutStep from "../components/checkout-step.vue";
import CheckoutSubmit from "../components/checkout-submit.vue";
import Field from "../components/field.vue";
import PaymentOptions from "../components/payment-options.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import SlotGrid from "../components/slot-grid.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title = "",
  days,
  payments,
  lines,
  rows,
  promos,
  labels,
  totals,
  layout = "cards",
  summary = "aside",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<CheckoutFormProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame :id="id" :title="title" :tone="tone" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel">
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-8 lg:grid-cols-3">
      <Form
        method="dialog"
        :class="
          (summary as string) === 'aside' ? 'flex flex-col gap-6 lg:col-span-2'
          : 'flex flex-col gap-6 lg:col-span-3'
        "
        data-testid="checkout-form"
      >
        <CheckoutStep number="1" :title="labels.contacts" :text="labels.contactsText" :layout="layout">
          <Grid cols="1-2" class="gap-4">
            <Field :label="labels.name" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-name', id)">
              <Input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="name" :id="tpl('{0}-name', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field :label="labels.phone" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-phone', id)">
              <Input type="tel" name="phone" autocomplete="tel" :id="tpl('{0}-phone', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field :label="labels.email" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-email', id)">
              <Input type="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
          </Grid>
        </CheckoutStep>
        <CheckoutStep number="2" :title="labels.address" :text="labels.addressText" :layout="layout">
          <Field :label="labels.street" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-street', id)">
            <Input type="text" name="street" autocomplete="address-line1" :id="tpl('{0}-street', id)" data-testid="field" />
          </Field>
          <Grid cols="2-4" class="gap-4">
            <Field :label="labels.house" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-house', id)">
              <Input type="text" name="house" :id="tpl('{0}-house', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field :label="labels.flat" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-flat', id)">
              <Input type="text" name="flat" :id="tpl('{0}-flat', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field :label="labels.entrance" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-entrance', id)">
              <Input type="text" name="entrance" :id="tpl('{0}-entrance', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
            <Field :label="labels.floor" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-floor', id)">
              <Input type="text" name="floor" :id="tpl('{0}-floor', id)" data-testid="field" />
            </Field>
          </Grid>
          <Field :label="labels.comment" :htmlFor="tpl('{0}-comment', id)">
            <Textarea :rows="4" name="comment" :id="tpl('{0}-comment', id)" data-testid="field" />
          </Field>
        </CheckoutStep>
        <CheckoutStep number="3" :title="labels.slot" :text="labels.slotText" :layout="layout">
          <SlotGrid :days="days" :name="tpl('{0}-slot', id)" item="plain" />
        </CheckoutStep>
        <CheckoutStep number="4" :title="labels.payment" :text="labels.paymentText" :layout="layout">
          <PaymentOptions :payments="payments" :name="tpl('{0}-payment', id)" checked="payment-card" />
        </CheckoutStep>
        <CheckoutSubmit :id="id" :consent="labels.consent" :submit="labels.submit" :legal="labels.legal" />
      </Form>
      <Box v-if="((summary as string) === 'aside')" class="lg:sticky lg:top-8" data-testid="aside">
        <CartSummaryCard
          :field="tpl('{0}-promo', id)"
          :lines="lines"
          :rows="rows"
          :promos="promos"
          :labels="totals"
          items="show"
        />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
